crowd_blade: Put that away, there are children here!
What's he want with a sword out in the street?
Not here. Not in the market.

crowd_blade.text: Come here, love, stand behind me.
Put it away! You'll have somebody's eye out!
Is he a knight? Is he going to fight?
I've seen what those do. Put it away, son.
In my day you'd be put in the stocks for that.
Not near my stall, if you please!
Sheathe it, or I'll not sell you so much as a turnip.
Weapons stay in their scabbards in {settlement}.
You. The blade. Put it away before I make you.
Planning on using that? Then put it away.
Steel out in the street? Not on my watch.
Go on then, swing it about. Fool.

crowd_fight: Ooh, that one'll leave a mark.
Keep it out of the street!
Mind the cart! Mind the cart!

crowd_fight.text: Get back from there, you'll get hurt!
Not in front of the children!
Young fools. It never ends well.
Not near the stalls, for pity's sake!
If he breaks anything of mine, he pays for it.
Wait till the reeve hears of this.

crowd_spectacle_brawl: That's for the ale, that is!
A mark on the big one.
Stop it, the pair of you!

crowd_spectacle_brawl.text: Every market day, the same thing.
Not against my stall, you oafs!
They'll be friends again by supper.

crowd_spectacle_body: Don't touch him, don't touch anything.

crowd_spectacle_body.text: Mama, why isn't he getting up?
God rest him. He was a good one.
Stand back. Nobody leaves till I say.
Lord have mercy on his soul.
I knew something like this would happen.

crowd_spectacle: Hush, hush, I want to hear.

crowd_spectacle.text: Lift me up, I can't see!
We had better ones when I was young.
Wait till they hear of this in the next village.

crowd_body: Is that... is that a body?
Was it you? Did you do this?

crowd_body.text: Don't you move. You've some explaining to do.

crowd_hero: There goes the one who saved us.
We'll not forget what you did.

crowd_hero.text: Can I carry your sword? Please?
I'm going to be like you when I'm grown!
My children are safe because of you.
I've lived a long time. Never seen the like of you.
For you, {player}, the best price in town.
Anything you need, you come to me first.
They'll sing about you, you know.
The saints sent you to us.

crowd_friend.text: Come by the stall later, I've something for you.
Fresh in today, {player}. Have a look.
Have you heard? No? I'll tell you later.

crowd_distrusted: That's the one I told you about.
What's that one doing back here?
I'd not trust that one with a hen.
Nothing good comes of their sort.

crowd_distrusted.text: Watch the stall, I'll not have them near it.
No credit for you. Coin first.
I've seen their kind before. Trouble.
Mutter mutter, eh? Say it to my face.
They say that one stole from the miller.

crowd_outlaw: Lock up, lock up, it's that one!

crowd_outlaw.text: Run home, run! Don't look back!
Not my takings, not my takings...
I'm too old to run. Lord keep me.
Murderer! The gallows wait for you!

crowd_armour.text: Plate on a market day? Expecting a war?
Heavy kit for a quiet town.
You'll want to keep that armour polite in {settlement}.
Who are you planning to fight, dressed like that?
Fine harness. Mind you don't start anything in it.
Sweating in all that iron, are we?
Going to a war, or coming back from one?
Mercenary? We've had trouble with your sort.
Good steel, that. Who made it?
If you ever want to sell that, come to me.
Rattling like a pot cart. Mind my wares.
That's a knight's worth of iron on you.
Armour like that wants oiling, you know.
Fresh from a battle, are we?
Plate in the heat of the steppe? Brave or mad.
Iron at sea's a quick way to the bottom, friend.

crowd_bloodied: There's a healer by the church, you know.
Been in the wars, have we?
Is that yours or someone else's?
Here, sit down before you fall down.

crowd_bloodied.text: Not near my wares, please, not with all that blood.
I had a wound like that once. Clean it, or it'll fester.
Who did that to you? Was it in town?
Poor soul. Let me pray for you.

crowd_prowl: I can see you, you know.
Up to no good, that one.

crowd_prowl.text: Bit late to be about, isn't it?
Honest folk are abed at this hour.
My shop's locked, I'll have you know.
Halt. What's your business at this hour?
Stand up straight where I can see you.
Creeping round the houses? I'll be watching you.
In my day thieves were hanged at the crossroads.
There's a thief about, I'd swear it.

crowd_brawl_yield: My nose... you've broke my nose.

crowd_brawl_part.text: Break it up! Break it up!
That's enough, the pair of you!
Apart! Now, or it's the stocks!
Another punch and you'll sleep in the cell.
Go home and sober up, both of you.
